# Issue templates

GitHub forms used when someone opens an issue on [KodYazicam/KY-GamePlayer](https://github.com/KodYazicam/KY-GamePlayer).

| File | When |
| --- | --- |
| `bug.yml` | Something crashed, failed to connect, or harvested wrong. Asks OS, Discord client, redacted logs. |
| `feature.yml` | New control or packaging change. Area dropdown matches the tabs / modules. |

Security issues: **not** here. Use a private advisory ([`../../SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md)).

Do not put live tokens in either form. Maintainers will close and rotate if a token is pasted in public.
